scripts.dev:emulators: pnpm --filter @hive/functions build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-hive --import packages/functions/emulator-seed
scripts.validate: pnpm validate:m0 && pnpm validate:m1 && pnpm validate:m2 && pnpm validate:m3 && pnpm validate:m4 && pnpm validate:m5
scripts.validate:m0: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter e2e test
scripts.validate:m2: HIVE_PROP_GAMES=500 pnpm --filter @hive/engine exec vitest run test/expansions-fixtures.test.ts test/property.test.ts
scripts.validate:m3: pnpm --filter @hive/app test && pnpm --filter e2e exec playwright test tests/hotseat.spec.ts tests/hotseat-drag.spec.ts && pnpm validate:visual && pnpm validate:ux
scripts.validate:m4: pnpm --filter @hive/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-hive --import packages/functions/emulator-seed "pnpm --filter @hive/app exec vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.ts && pnpm --filter e2e exec playwright test -c playwright.mp.config.ts"
scripts.validate:visual: pnpm --filter e2e exec playwright test -c playwright.visual.config.ts visual/gallery.spec.ts
scripts.validate:ux: pnpm --filter e2e exec playwright test -c playwright.visual.config.ts visual/ux.spec.ts
scripts.validate:m5: pnpm --filter @hive/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-hive --import packages/functions/emulator-seed "pnpm --filter e2e exec playwright test -c playwright.offline.config.ts"
